title: openssl-x509: change of behaviour for public key output between versions 1.0.2 and 1.1.1
root_cause: Change in behavior of public key output in OpenSSL x509 command between versions 1.0.2 and 1.1.1
reproduction_command: openssl x509 -in cert.crt -inform der -out cert.pem -pubkey > pubkey.pem
